newsitem.title: UK: John Lewis UK dept stores sales up 11.7% latest wk.
newsitem.headline: John Lewis UK dept stores sales up 11.7% latest wk.

text.p: The John Lewis Partnership said its UK department store sales rose 11.7 percent in the week to March 22 over the same week a year ago.
There was a rise of 8.8 percent in the eight weeks to March 22.

Total sales, including those from the Waitrose supermarket chain, rose 8.3 percent in the week to March 22 compared with the year earlier week. There was a rise of 6.6 percent for the eight-week trading period.
